text:
Hi everyone!
My husband (Israeli)and I (German) applied for the A5 Visa in March. We still didn't have our first interview because we are waiting for one last document from Germany to be sent. 

Currently I'm on a tourist visa and we wanted to fly to Germany to visit my family in July/August. Can I come back to Israel on a tourist Visa once I'm out of the country and the visa process still being open? Is there any way to get permission for a one time fly out/come back? 

Another situation is that my tourist visa expires at the end of July. If we still don't have an invitation for our first interview by then, will my tourist visa be extended or do I have to leave the country until we get an invitation? 

I'm very thankful for help and reports about experiences in similar situations 🙏
